name: The Rushing Waters

npcs.name: Lola Teresa
dialogue: Rain has turned the creek into fast-moving floodwater.
Take the raised path to high ground. Do not try to cross the current.
after_dialogue: We are above the water now. Wait for local officials to say the route is safe.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need the drinking water. Please bring it, then help me get to the marked shelter.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the marked shelter now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the drinking water, then speak with Lola Teresa again.

choice.prompt: The main crossing is under fast water. What route should we take?

options.result: Choose the marked high route and leave stranded supplies.
options.consequence: You chose the marked high-ground route.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.result: Crossing moving water is dangerous. The short route damages the response team’s supplies.
options.consequence: You entered a flooded route despite the warning.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

items.name: Recover the marked signal component from the mud

quests.title: Find a first-aid kit for the evacuation to high ground.
Recover the marked signal component from the mud

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.community: Find Lola Teresa and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach High Ground / School and stay clear of danger.

lessons: Never walk or drive through floodwater; depth and current can be hard to judge.
Move to higher ground and follow local evacuation instructions.
Keep emergency supplies and a family communication plan ready.

quiz.question: Floodwater covers your planned route. What should you do?
options: Turn around and use a safe route directed by local authorities
Walk through if it looks shallow
Follow a vehicle through the water
quiz.explanation: Floodwater depth and current are difficult to judge. Never walk or drive through it.

briefing: Rain turns a creek into fast-moving floodwater and cuts off the main road. Help Lola Teresa reach high ground, avoid entering moving water, and decide whether a stranded supply is safe to recover. Search the mud for a marked electronic component after the water recedes.
story_clue: The recovered component contains part of the same repeating signal.
